content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Problem:
To go on a boat, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Check the local marine weather forecast (10 minutes)
Step 2. Load the cooler with ice and drinks (20 minutes)
Step 3. Inspect the boat hull for any damage (30 minutes)
Step 4. Renew the annual vessel registration (2 days)
Step 5. Purchase a new set of life jackets (1 hour)
Step 6. Apply waterproof sunscreen (15 minutes)
Step 7. Check the engine oil levels (10 minutes)
Step 8. Test the bilge pump operation (5 minutes)
Step 9. Verify the fire extinguisher expiration date (5 minutes)
Step 10. Flush the outboard motor with fresh water (15 minutes)
Step 11. Charge the auxiliary trolling motor battery (8 hours)
Step 12. Secure the drain plug in the transom (2 minutes)
Step 13. Double-check the fuel levels in the main tank (5 minutes)
Step 14. Update the GPS navigation charts (45 minutes)
Step 15. Research nearby public boat ramps (20 minutes)
Step 16. Pack the emergency first aid kit (30 minutes)

Step 19. Pack the dry bag with towels and spare clothes (15 minutes)

Step 25. Buy a local fishing license (15 minutes)
Step 26. Organize the tackle box (40 minutes)

Step 28. Attach the trailer to the truck hitch (20 minutes)

Step 30. Board the vessel (5 minutes)

Step 35. Store the life jackets in an accessible spot (10 minutes)
Step 36. Check the propeller for tangled fishing line (10 minutes)
Step 37. Inspect the winch strap for fraying (10 minutes)
Step 38. Plan the specific cruise route (30 minutes)
Step 39. Pack a handheld compass as backup (5 minutes)
Step 40. Check the horn for functionality (2 minutes)
Step 41. Brief the passengers on safety procedures (15 minutes)
Step 42. Check the tide charts for the afternoon (10 minutes)
Step 43. Finalize the float plan and tell a friend (15 minutes)
Step 44. Prepare the bait for fishing (30 minutes)
Step 45. Put on sunglasses and a hat (5 minutes)

Step 48. Buy a bag of oranges and snacks (20 minutes)
Step 49. Check the wallet for identification (5 minutes)
Step 50. Buy a pair of non-slip boat shoes (1 hour)
Step 51. Look up the marina's operating hours (10 minutes)
Step 52. Buy a waterproof phone case (20 minutes)
Step 53. Mix the two-stroke oil if necessary (15 minutes)
Step 54. Wipe down the steering wheel (5 minutes)
Step 55. Retrieve the boat keys from the hook (5 minutes)
Step 56. Load the snorkeling gear (15 minutes)
Step 57. Check the flares' expiration dates (5 minutes)
Step 58. Start the engine to warm it up (10 minutes)
Step 59. Sweep out the cabin area (20 minutes)
Step 60. Check the wind speed and direction (5 minutes)
Step 61. Back the trailer down the ramp (15 minutes)
Step 62. Untie the transit tie-down straps (5 minutes)
Step 63. Fill the bait well with water (10 minutes)
Step 64. Wash the exterior hull (45 minutes)
Step 65. Buy a spare whistle for signaling (10 minutes)
Step 66. Inspect the fuel line for cracks (10 minutes)
Step 67. Buy a new docking fender (30 minutes)
Step 68. Check the depth sounder settings (5 minutes)
Step 69. Confirm the cell phone is fully charged (1 hour)
Step 70. Locate the registration paperwork (10 minutes)
